metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: I. Prelude in C major

sections.label: Opening cell
sections.explanation: An eight-note rising-and-folding arpeggio opens the cycle; an inner song gradually emerges. Prepared suspensions at bar 3, bar 8 delay the new harmony and resolve downward.

sections.label: Contrasting span
sections.explanation: The characteristic figure returns with changed harmony, density or register. Prepared suspensions at bar 9 delay the new harmony and resolve downward.

sections.label: Development
sections.explanation: The characteristic figure returns with changed harmony, density or register. Prepared suspensions at bar 17 delay the new harmony and resolve downward.

sections.label: Return
sections.explanation: The characteristic figure returns with changed harmony, density or register.

sections.label: Cadence
sections.explanation: The upper leading note rises by semitone to the tonic; the inner dominant seventh resolves downward.

composition_notes: An eight-note rising-and-folding arpeggio opens the cycle; an inner song gradually emerges.
The opening folded arpeggio is retained; the inner song now crosses barlines smoothly, with prepared delays near the harmonic returns.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
